title: rhododendron lanigerum var. silvaticum
intro: Rhododendron lanigerum var. silvaticum, commonly known as the hairy rhododendron, is a shrub species belonging to the family Ericaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of R. lanigerum var. silvaticum include reducing inflammation, acting as an antiseptic, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
